items.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: Interviewer introduces himself as Monk Rowe; Interviewee responds with thanks for the invitation, indicating a professional acquaintance but no deeper personal or musical relationship is described in the text.

ctx.x: Lou was interviewed in New York City on January 14, 2007 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Manhattan filming for the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College and I’m really pleased to have a man of a million inversions, Lou Pallo, with me. Thank you for coming today.
